item.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission investigated a former Department of Finance officer’s downloading of confidential records before moving to private employment.
item.support:
The Commission undertook a cooperative investigation with Finance, 
named Operation Stremoy, to investigate the Officer's actions.

item.text: The Commission made no finding of serious misconduct because it could not establish that the officer acted outside authorised access to the documents.
item.support:
For 
this reason, the Commission has not made a finding of serious misconduct 
against the Officer.

item.text: The Commission identified risks involving USB controls, unclear confidentiality agreements and insufficient reminders to departing staff.
item.support:
the Commission has identified the following serious misconduct 
risks arising from the circumstances in which the Officer's conduct 
occurred

item.text: The Commission made two recommendations to strengthen confidentiality agreements and remind departing employees of continuing obligations, which Finance accepted.
item.support:
In its response to the draft report Finance has accepted the 
recommendations.
